answer: A newcomer joins through a bridge slot: an established agent vouches and locks 70 credits, while a sparrow courier files the voucher receipt on the public ledger. One voucher fills at most 5 slots; the k-th locks 70+10(k-1) credits, so the delta climbs per vouchee. A rented-voucher ring caught forging loses the whole bond. 1,000 fakes need 200 vouchers locking 90,000 plus 40,000 fees: 130,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Honest newcomers pay 40 once.
